Ulipsu Building Skill Infrastructure Aligned with India's NEP

Ulipsu is developing skill infrastructure in India that aligns with the National Education Policy (NEP). This initiative aims to enhance the country's educational and vocational training landscape. The focus is on building a framework that supports skill development as envisioned by the NEP.
